blocks.title: Phase
blocks.text: Zawiya theta = wt, jo S.H.M. mein jhoolte nuqte ka displacement aur harkat ki simt dono batata hai, phase kehlata hai. Phase oscillator ki harkat ki halat dikhata hai.

Aam taur par displacement x = xo cos(wt + phi) (14.18) likha jata hai. Waqt ke saath badalti miqdar (wt + phi) harkat ka phase hai; yeh kisi waqt harkat ki halat batati hai. Constant phi phase constant (ya phase angle) hai; is ki qeemat t = 0 par zarre ke displacement aur velocity par munhasir hai. Miqdar phi do oscillators ki harkat ki halaton ka phase farq bhi batati hai.

items: phi = 0: x = xo cos(wt). t = 0, T/2 aur T (theta = 0, pi aur 2 pi) par nuqta inteha ki jagah par hai; t = T/4 aur 3T/4 (theta = pi/2 aur 3 pi/2) par darmiyani jagah par.

blocks.alt: Aik period T mein displacement aur waqt ka graph; T/4, T/2, 3T/4 aur T likhe hain, xo aur -xo par dashed lakeerein. Curve +xo se shuru, T/4 par sifar, T/2 par -xo, 3T/4 par sifar aur T par wapas +xo.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.8 (a): phi = 0 darje ke liye x = xo cos(wt + phi) ka graph (kitab ki Figure 14.8 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: phi = 90 darje: x = xo cos(wt + 90 darje). t = 0, T/2 aur T par nuqta darmiyani jagah par hai; T/4 aur 3T/4 par inteha par.

blocks.alt: Aik period mein displacement ka graph. Curve sifar se shuru, T/4 par -xo tak girta, T/2 par sifar, 3T/4 par +xo aur T par wapas sifar.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.8 (b): phi = 90 darje ke liye x = xo cos(wt + phi) ka graph (kitab ki Figure 14.8 (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: phi = 180 darje: x = xo cos(wt + 180 darje) = -xo cos(wt): harkat pehli ke bilkul ulat hai.

blocks.alt: Aik period mein displacement ka graph. Curve -xo se shuru, T/4 par sifar, T/2 par +xo, 3T/4 par sifar aur T par wapas -xo: graph (a) ka aaina (mirror image).
blocks.caption: Figure 14.8 (c): phi = 180 darje ke liye x = xo cos(wt + phi) ka graph (kitab ki Figure 14.8 (c) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon graph dekhein: amplitude aur period aik jaise hain, sirf shuru ki jagah mukhtalif hai. (a) +xo se, (b) sifar se neeche ki taraf, (c) -xo se shuru hota hai. Kitab ne (b) ke neeche caption 'phi = 0' aur (c) ke neeche 'phi = 90 darje' chhapa hai, aur (c) mein neeche wale nishaan par -xo ki jagah 'xo' likha hai; durust (b) phi = 90 darje aur (c) phi = 180 darje hai, aur khaake isi ke mutabiq hain. (a) aur (c) hamesha O ke ulat taraf hain: yeh out of phase hain.
Jab do jhoolte nizamon ka phase farq 180 darje ho to woh out of phase jhoolte hain; jab 0 ya 360 darje ho to in phase.

blocks.title: Fig 14.8 ke captions
blocks.text: Kitab mein Fig 14.8 (b) ka caption phi = 0 aur Fig 14.8 (c) ka phi = 90 darje hai; matan ke mutabiq yeh phi = 90 darje aur phi = 180 darje hone chahiye. Matan ka 'theta = 0, pi aur 2' asal mein 0, pi aur 2 pi hai.

0.5 kg kamiyat k = 200 N m^-1 wale spring se bandhi hai. Ise tawazun se 0.2 m hata kar rest se chhora jata hai. S.H.M. farz karte hue t = 0.5 s par displacement, velocity aur acceleration maloom karein. Hal: w = (k/m) ka square root = (200/0.5) ka square root = 20 rad s^-1, aur kyunke yeh inteha par rest se shuru hota hai, x = xo cos(wt). t = 0.5 s par wt = 10 rad, aur cos(10 rad) = -0.839, sin(10 rad) = -0.544. Displacement: x = 0.2 x (-0.839) = -0.168 m. Velocity: v = -xo w sin(wt) = -(0.2)(20)(-0.544) = +2.18 m s^-1. Acceleration: a = -w^2 x = -(400)(-0.168) = +67.1 m s^-2.

blocks.title: Misal 14.4 mein nishanaat
blocks.text: Kitab cos(10) ko +0.839 aur sin(10) ko +0.544 leti hai, aur x = +0.168 m, v = 2.176 m s^-1 aur a = -67.12 m s^-2 deti hai. Zawiya radian mein ho to cos(10) aur sin(10) dono manfi hain, is liye kamiyat O ki doosri taraf hai: x = -0.168 m, v = +2.18 m s^-1 aur a = +67.1 m s^-2 (miqdarein wahi). Hissa (c) 't = 0.05 s' bhi chhapa hai. Jaanch ke liye nishan zada.

blocks.prompt: Do aik jaise pendulum is tarah jhoolte hain ke jab aik daen inteha par ho to doosra baen inteha par. Un ka phase farq kya hai?
blocks.explanation: 180 darje (pi radian): woh out of phase hain.

items: Phase (wt + phi) harkat ki halat batata; phi phase constant.
Phase farq 0 ya 360 darje: in phase; 180 darje: out of phase.
